text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up 1 Harbor Labs pilot submitted week-2 feedback. Can product triage so CS can set renewal expectations?

maria_cs: Key asks: 1) route-level billing breakdown 2) org-scoped embeddings export 3) offline agent sync for air-gapped sites 4) admin RBAC 5) SSO + provisioning

devin_pm: Which are blockers for their pilot/renewal?

maria_cs: Route billing and offline sync are blockers. Renewal in ~5 weeks; finance is anxious about billing visibility.

noah_eng: Ballpark effort: route billing ~2 devs x 5-7w, offline sync ~3-4 devs x 8-10w, embeddings export ~1 dev x 2w, RBAC/SSO ~2-3w each.

devin_pm: Priority = billing > offline sync > RBAC/SSO > export. Any temporary mitigations?

maria_cs: We offered a daily CSV split export for billing and a limited PoC for offline sites. Customer said CSV is acceptable for up to 6 weeks if we commit to roadmap.

ops-bot: Created RD-4412: "Harbor: route billing interim export + RFC" assigned to @noah_eng.

noah_eng: I'll spike an API-only path to reduce console work and try to shave ~2 weeks. Adding acceptance criteria to RD-4412.

devin_pm: Please add impact/effort to roadmap board (billing Impact=9 Effort=8, offline Impact=8 Effort=9).

maria_cs: Customer replied with ranking: 1) billing 2) offline sync 3) SSO 4) RBAC 5) export. Renewal risk = elevated if billing not committed.

devin_pm: Thanks. Actions: maria confirm CSV acceptance in writing; noah add spike; devin schedule 30m grooming. Closing thread for now.
